title: Worksheet — Polynomials (Class 10 CBSE Mathematics)
instructions: Attempt all 10 questions. Show all working. Total time: 50 minutes.

questions.question: A polynomial of degree n has at most n real zeros.
If α and β are zeros of ax² + bx + c, then αβ = ____.
For x² − 5x + 6, the sum of zeros is:
If a quadratic has discriminant 0, its graph:
options: crosses the x-axis at two points
touches the x-axis at one point
questions.answer: touches the x-axis at one point

questions.question: Find the zeros of x² − 5x + 6 by factorisation, and verify the sum-and-product relations.
questions.answer: x² − 5x + 6 = (x − 2)(x − 3); zeros are 2 and 3. Sum = 5 = −b/a ✓. Product = 6 = c/a ✓.

questions.question: If α and β are zeros of x² − 7x + 10, find: (i) α + β, (ii) αβ, (iii) α² + β², (iv) 1/α + 1/β.
Construct a quadratic whose zeros are 3 + √2 and 3 − √2.
If α, β, γ are zeros of x³ + 2x² − 5x − 6, find: (i) α + β + γ, (ii) αβ + βγ + γα, (iii) αβγ.
Divide p(x) = 3x³ + x² + 2x + 5 by g(x) = x² + 2x + 1 using the division algorithm. Show every step. Verify p = g·q + r.
questions.answer: Step 1: 3x³ ÷ x² = 3x. 3x·(x²+2x+1) = 3x³+6x²+3x. Subtract from p: (3x³+x²+2x+5) − (3x³+6x²+3x) = −5x²−x+5. Step 2: −5x² ÷ x² = −5. −5·(x²+2x+1) = −5x²−10x−5. Subtract: 9x+10 (degree 1 < 2; STOP). Quotient = 3x − 5; remainder = 9x + 10. Verify: g·q + r = (x²+2x+1)(3x−5) + (9x+10) = 3x³+x²+2x+5 ✓.

questions.question: Two zeros of x³ − 4x² + x + 6 are 2 and −1. Find the third zero using the division algorithm.
questions.answer: Divide x³ − 4x² + x + 6 by (x − 2)(x + 1) = x² − x − 2. Long division: x³ ÷ x² = x. x·(x² − x − 2) = x³ − x² − 2x. Subtract: −3x² + 3x + 6. −3x² ÷ x² = −3. −3·(x² − x − 2) = −3x² + 3x + 6. Subtract: 0. So quotient = x − 3; third factor (x − 3) → third zero is 3.
questions.explanation: Use known zeros + division to find missing zero.
